parameters.query: INSERT INTO documents (id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, ai_tags, ai_confidence, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ $json.originalName }}', '{{ $json.newName }}', '/storage/{{ $json.newName }}', {{ $json.body.file.size }}, '{{ $json.body.file.type }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.tags) }}', {{ $json.confidence }}, '{{ $json.category }}', '{{ $json.body.metadata.userId }}', NOW()) RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, timestamp, metadata) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ $json.body.metadata.userId }}', 'DOCUMENT_UPLOAD', 'document', (SELECT id FROM documents WHERE stored_name = '{{ $json.newName }}' LIMIT 1), '{{ $json.body.metadata.ipAddress || 'unknown' }}', NOW(), '{{ JSON.stringify({fileName: $json.newName, category: $json.category}) }}');

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, document: $json, message: 'Document uploaded and processed successfully' } }}
